purpose: Teach: 貴文/幸雄/十郎/洋一/博之/一夫/僕達/がわり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「貴文おじさんに会いに行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying he wanted to go visit Uncle Takafumi.
lines.style: Warm, gently informative. Mei relaying what she heard, not pressing. Soft opening, steady pace. A little tender — noticing Sho's world expanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと幸雄おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went with Dad and Uncle Yukio!
lines.style: Bright, excited rush on the opening. Quick pace, genuine bounce in the voice. The pride of a six-year-old who's been somewhere important and remembers it clearly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「十郎おじさんは寡黙だけど優しい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said Uncle Juro is quiet, but he's kind.
lines.style: Conversational relay, almost musing. Mei processing what she heard, sharing it gently. A slight pause before 'kind' — like she's endorsing it herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと洋一おじさんと釣りに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went fishing with Dad and Uncle Yoichi!
lines.style: Bright and energetic, slightly breathless. Voice climbs on 'fishing' — this was the good part. Quick, eager delivery, the happiness of a small child who did something grown-up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「博之おじさんと水族館へ」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad mentioned going to the aquarium with Uncle Hiroshi.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. Mei continuing the thread, voice warm and patient. She's noticing the pattern — each uncle, each memory — and there's something fond in how she's telling it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと一夫おじさんの家でカレー食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I had curry at Uncle Kazuo's house with Dad!
lines.style: Delighted and full. Brightness on 'curry' — food, family, togetherness. Quick pace, genuine warmth. The contentment of a small voice remembering something cozy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「僕達家族はみんな仲良し」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said something really sweet: our whole family gets along so well together.
lines.style: Tender, almost reflective. Mei's voice softens here — this is the emotional centre. Slow pace, each word clear. A little breathiness, like she's moved by what Ryosuke said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「日がわりメニュー、つまりひがわりの店」に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went to this restaurant with Dad where they change the menu every day!
lines.style: Cheerful, warm close. The excitement is gentler now — not a shout, but a genuine, satisfied smile in the voice. Slight trailing-off at the end, like Sho's happy to have shared all this.
